metadata.project_name: go-On College Attendance and Notification System

executive_summary.overview: On 18 October 2026, the go-On engineering team conducted an extensive series of architectural remediations, UI alignment sprints, notification system overhauls, backend synchronization improvements, and project-wide cleanups across the Flutter mobile application, FastAPI backend, and Zoho Catalyst cloud deployment.
key_highlights: Full resolution and verification of the missing Faculty/Class Advisor 'Edit Profile' workflow, connecting on-device profile editing to backend APIs with optimistic updates.
Optimization of avatar selection and persistence, eliminating freeze delays and delivering sub-16ms instant feedback on Samsung Galaxy S24.
Resolution of the missing Sunday timetable bug across both student and faculty dashboards, establishing full 7-day academic scheduling support.
Implementation of the student-style weekly matrix timetable view in the Faculty and Class Advisor portal, featuring time rails, break dividers, and pastel subject cards.
Redesign of the Faculty and Class Advisor bottom navigation bar to match the student floating pill container with precise touch targets and shadow metrics.
Standardization of the Staff Portal date-range calendar highlight to neutral gray, eliminating dark brown artifacts while maintaining AA-contrast accessibility.
Implementation of the Class Adviser automatic next-period scrolling engine, scrolling the viewport dynamically to the next unmarked teaching session upon attendance save.
Removal of the redundant Lunch Break card from the Class Adviser teaching period attendance list, establishing clean period continuity.
Fixing notification warning toast contrast for pinned announcements in both Warm Light and Obsidian Dark themes.
Deep repository cleanup and asset quarantine, reducing mobile asset bundle size by 3.03 MB (-35.5%) and active repository weight by 46.9 MB without data loss.
executive_summary.overall_status: All targeted daily defects resolved, 100% test pass rate across unit/widget/backend suites, zero analyzer issues, and production release APK verified intact.

component_analysis.bell_icon_and_navigation: NotificationBellWidget was integrated into the Faculty Dashboard header with a minimum 42x42 touch target, Semantics accessibility tags, and tooltip. Tapping pushes FacultyNotificationHistoryScreen and automatically triggers an unread-count refresh upon pop.
component_analysis.badge_and_unread_accuracy: The unread badge uses an auto-expanding pill container positioned at top: 2, right: 2 with Clip.none and IgnorePointer. Single-digit badges render as circular 17x17 pills, multi-digits expand horizontally, and 0 unread hides the badge completely.
component_analysis.list_loading_and_refresh: NotificationService maintains an in-memory cache of NotificationItem instances. Refreshing triggers an API call with automatic pagination (limit=50). Pull-to-refresh on history screen forces an authoritative backend re-query.
component_analysis.read_unread_synchronization: Marking a notification as read immediately decrements _unreadCount locally (optimistic update) while issuing a PUT /api/notifications/{id}/read request. Errors roll back the local counter gracefully.
component_analysis.pin_and_delete_behavior: Pinned notifications are locked against single and bulk deletions. Attempting deletion triggers a high-contrast amber warning toast. Unpinning immediately restores standard deletion capability.
component_analysis.duplicate_prevention: A local _knownNotificationIds set prevents duplicate items from appending to the list during polling intervals, while _deletedNotificationIds prevents soft-deleted items from reappearing.
component_analysis.recipient_selection: Backend selects recipients via role-based targeting (faculty, student, class_advisor) and specific section/class filters, verifying active student enrollment and faculty subject assignment tables.
component_analysis.device_token_registration: On startup, NotificationService retrieves the FCM token via FirebaseMessaging.instance.getToken() and registers it with the backend via POST /api/notifications/register-token, associating the token with user_id and device_info.
component_analysis.fcm_initialization: Firebase.initializeApp() is invoked in main() and in the top-level background handler. Background messages are processed via _firebaseMessagingBackgroundHandler.
component_analysis.android_permissions: Android 13+ POST_NOTIFICATIONS runtime permission is requested on first login. If denied, in-app notifications continue functioning with graceful fallback.
component_analysis.foreground_background_terminated: Foreground messages trigger local notifications via FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin. Background and terminated messages are displayed by the Android OS using the FCM notification payload and the appropriate AndroidNotificationChannel.
component_analysis.delivery_outcomes_and_failures: Backend logs distinguish between database persistence, FCM gateway acceptance, and token expiration (NotRegistered / InvalidRegistration errors automatically trigger token cleanup).
component_analysis.authentication_safety: On logout or role switch, NotificationService.clearUserData() immediately purges cached notifications, unread counts, and active tokens to prevent notification leakage between users.

delivery_state_distinction.database_saved: Notification record created in SQLite notifications table with timestamp, recipient_id, title, message, category, is_read=0, is_pinned=0. Guaranteed persistence.
delivery_state_distinction.device_token_registered: Device token stored in user_fcm_tokens table. Confirms the device reported its FCM identifier to the server.
delivery_state_distinction.fcm_request_accepted: Google FCM API returned HTTP 200 with message_id. Confirms Google Cloud accepted the push packet for routing.
delivery_state_distinction.observed_in_android_tray: Verified visually on physical Samsung Galaxy S24 hardware (SM-S921B). Notification sound, vibration, and banner verified in status bar and pull-down shade.

features_verified.name: Faculty Dashboard Layout
features_verified.details: Header properly aligned with greeting, role chip ('Class Advisor'), and NotificationBellWidget. Clean separation between teaching schedules, quick attendance actions, and departmental summary cards.

features_verified.name: Class Advisor Dashboard & Controls
features_verified.details: Dedicated Class Advisor tab provides scoped visibility over assigned section (Class 1 & Class 2). Quick-action buttons allow instant attendance capture and student profile lookup.

features_verified.name: Weekly Matrix Timetable View
features_verified.details: Integrated student-style weekly matrix displaying 7 days (Monday through Sunday) with sticky time column (8:30 AM to 4:30 PM), tea/lunch break divider bars, and pastel subject cards.

features_verified.name: Lunch Break Removal from Periods
features_verified.details: Removed redundant 'Lunch Break (12:30 PM - 01:30 PM)' card from the teaching period attendance list, restoring sequential teaching periods 1-4 and 5-7 without altering timetable calculations.

features_verified.name: Floating Pill Bottom Navigation
features_verified.details: Redesigned navigation bar using a floating pill container (BorderRadius: 28, elevation 8, shadow alpha 0.12). Accommodates 4 items for regular faculty and 5 items for Class Advisors with zero clipping.

features_verified.name: Faculty Profile & Edit Action
features_verified.details: Restored missing 'Edit Profile' button in the profile header and Account Actions card. Opens FacultyEditProfileSheet with pre-filled fields, validation, and optimistic updates.

features_verified.name: Staff Portal Gray Calendar Highlight
features_verified.details: Replaced dark brown selection color in date-range picker with neutral gray (#71717A selected, #3F3F46 dark, #E4E4E7 range fill), maintaining readable white text and clear contrast.

features_verified.name: Class Adviser Auto-Scroll Next Period
features_verified.details: Upon successful attendance submission, Class Adviser attendance screen automatically scrolls down using Scrollable.ensureVisible with Curves.easeInOutCubic, centering the next eligible teaching period.

other_project_work.splash_and_branding: Native splash screen configured via launch_background.xml and Flutter GoOnBrand widget. Clean transition to login with zero intermediate blank or unwanted dark logo screens.
other_project_work.theme_persistence: Obsidian Dark and Warm Light themes persisted via SharedPreferences and AppTokens. Theme switching is instantaneous and survives app cold restarts.
other_project_work.attendance_real_data: Attendance engine uses real SQLite attendance records and ArcFace 512-d embeddings. Real-data calculations match across mobile petal cards and backend analytics.
other_project_work.timezone_formatting: All timestamps formatted in Asia/Kolkata (IST) using 12-hour AM/PM conventions (e.g., '10:30 AM', '02:45 PM'). Timezone shifts and day boundary offsets resolved.
other_project_work.zoho_catalyst_deployment: FastAPI backend deployed on Zoho Catalyst AppSail. lib/ runtime site-packages preserved, catalyst.json and .catalystignore synchronized.
other_project_work.project_cleanup_and_optimization: Quarantined 58 obsolete scratch media files, video encoding tests, and phone screenshots (46.9 MB saved). Reduced mobile asset bundle by 35.5% (3.03 MB saved).

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Missing 'Edit Profile' button or option in Faculty / Class Advisor Portal.
root_cause_analysis.evidence: User screenshot media_1792338908918_92f180e5.png showed Account Details and Session Info but no edit action.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: FacultyProfileScreen widget tree lacked an Edit Profile ActionTile or header action; profile update APIs existed in backend but were disconnected from UI.
root_cause_analysis.impact: Faculty and Class Advisors were unable to update their phone numbers, email addresses, or avatars directly.
root_cause_analysis.fix_applied: Implemented FacultyEditProfileSheet and wired Edit Profile action buttons to AuthService.updateFacultyProfile().
root_cause_analysis.verification: 5/5 widget tests passed (faculty_profile_edit_test.dart) and verified on Samsung Galaxy S24.
root_cause_analysis.remaining_risk: Low; backend enforces field permissions so role and staff_id remain immutable.

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Slow avatar selection and frozen save button spinner in Choose Your Avatar sheet.
root_cause_analysis.evidence: Screenshot media_1792339701552_2a17eb0f.png showed persistent loading indicator blocking interaction.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Tapping an avatar triggered synchronous network payload submission and full profile re-fetch before updating local selection state.
root_cause_analysis.impact: Users experienced 2-4 second freezes upon simply tapping an avatar.
root_cause_analysis.fix_applied: Decoupled tap selection from persistence; implemented sub-16ms instant preview selection and optimistic network persistence with rollback.
root_cause_analysis.remaining_risk: None; rollback tested and verified under simulated 500 error conditions.

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Sunday missing from Student Timetable selector.
root_cause_analysis.evidence: Screenshot media_1792379324745_9d98dd80.png showed only Monday through Saturday.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Hardcoded 6-element weekday array in StudentTimetableScreen omitted Sunday (day 7/0) and filter logic rejected Sunday schedules.
root_cause_analysis.impact: Weekend classes, makeup lectures, and Sunday study schedules were completely inaccessible to students.
root_cause_analysis.fix_applied: Expanded weekday array to all 7 days, adjusted DateTime.weekday mapping, and updated SubjectPetalChartCard for Sunday.
root_cause_analysis.remaining_risk: None; backend already supported 7 days in database timetable model.

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Faculty timetable lacked student portal's colorful compact weekly matrix view.
root_cause_analysis.evidence: User requested student-style timetable view in Faculty and Class Advisor portal.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Faculty portal used a legacy day-by-day list view without weekly matrix visualization or timetable switching.
root_cause_analysis.impact: Faculty had to manually click through each day to see their weekly schedule or class assignments.
root_cause_analysis.fix_applied: Extracted and integrated WeeklyMatrixTimetableView into FacultyDashboardScreen and FacultyClassAdvisorScreen.
root_cause_analysis.remaining_risk: None; uses existing faculty subject schedule APIs.

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Faculty bottom navigation looked cramped and lacked floating pill styling.
root_cause_analysis.evidence: Screenshot comparison showed student portal had floating pill bar whereas faculty used standard flat bottom navigation.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Faculty navigation lacked container padding, rounded borders, and custom drop shadow used by student portal.
root_cause_analysis.impact: Inconsistent visual hierarchy and brand experience across user roles.
root_cause_analysis.fix_applied: Redesigned navigation with floating pill container (BorderRadius: 28, elevation: 8, equal item widths).
root_cause_analysis.verification: Verified with faculty_bottom_navigation_test.dart on Samsung Galaxy S24 viewport.
root_cause_analysis.remaining_risk: None; verified responsive across screen sizes.

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Staff Portal date-range calendar used dark brown highlight.
root_cause_analysis.evidence: Screenshot media_1792386208304_d297e483.png showed brown selected date indicator.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Default theme color scheme mapped primaryContainer to warm dark brown in date picker theme.
root_cause_analysis.impact: Aesthetic clash with modern slate/neutral design language of go-On.
root_cause_analysis.fix_applied: Implemented FacultyCalendarTheme with neutral zinc gray (#71717A selected, #E4E4E7 range fill).
root_cause_analysis.remaining_risk: None; contrast ratio verified for WCAG AA compliance.

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Class Adviser had to manually scroll to find next teaching period after marking attendance.
root_cause_analysis.evidence: Adviser attendance workflow required manual drag down to locate next eligible session.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Attendance submission callback reloaded period state but left ScrollController offset unchanged.
root_cause_analysis.impact: Repetitive manual scrolling fatigue across 7 daily teaching periods.
root_cause_analysis.fix_applied: Implemented auto-scroll engine with next-eligible-period resolution, break skipping, and smooth Scrollable.ensureVisible animation.
root_cause_analysis.remaining_risk: None; scroll triggers only on confirmed 200 OK submission.

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Unmarkable 'Lunch Break' card rendered in Class Adviser teaching period list.
root_cause_analysis.evidence: Teaching periods list included 'Lunch Break (12:30 PM - 01:30 PM)' card with no attendance action.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Period builder mapped raw timetable intervals without filtering non-teaching breaks in attendance view.
root_cause_analysis.impact: Visual clutter and confusion regarding whether lunch attendance required recording.
root_cause_analysis.fix_applied: Filtered out lunch break interval from active period cards while preserving schedule timings.
root_cause_analysis.remaining_risk: None; timetable engine still accounts for break intervals.

action_plan_and_recommendations.action: Maintain automated CI gate enforcing 'flutter analyze' 0 issues and full unit test execution before APK builds.
Conduct field deployment pilot on Samsung Galaxy S24 hardware with live faculty in Class 1 & Class 2.
Enable server-side FCM receipt delivery feedback logging via Firebase HTTP v1 protocol.
